Opposite Party/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Rajan
 For the State : Mr.Ajay Mishra
 For the Vigilance : Mr.Arvind Kumar
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Satyavrat Verma
 Oral Order
1.  Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Special P. P. for the Vigilance and learned APP for the State.
2. The petitioner seeks bail in anticipation of his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 467, 468, 471, 420 and 120(B) of the Indian Penal Code.

3. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is a person with clean antecedent and has been falsely implicated in the instant case with an allegation that he secured appointment as Panchayat Teacher based on forged and fabricated mark-sheets.
It is next submitted that the F.I.R. came to be instituted based on an inquiry conducted behind the back of the petitioner.
It is next submitted that had an opportunity Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.77609 of 2023(4) dt.16-04-2024 been given to the petitioner to explain his case
, perhaps the F.I.R. would not have been instituted.
It is also submitted that the petitioner stands terminated from service even.
4. Learned Special P.P. opposes the anticipatory bail application.

10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned C.J.M., Bettiah, West Champaran in connection with Shikarpur P. S. Case No.21 of 2023,
